prompt: Implement a p=1 QAOA circuit for MaxCut on the 3-node triangle graph with edges (0,1), (1,2), (0,2), using the FIXED parameters gamma = 0.5 and beta = 0.3. Steps: Hadamard on all 3 qubits. Cost layer: for each edge (i,j) in the order (0,1), (1,2), (0,2), apply CNOT(i,j), then RZ(2*gamma, j), then CNOT(i,j) again. Mixer layer: apply RX(2*beta) to every qubit. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H or RX directly — decompose them into this gate set. Return the resulting 3-qubit state; no measurement.
